entities.name: Michał Węsławski
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Michał Joachim Alojzy Węsławski was a Polish lawyer and politician who served as the Vilnius city councillor from 1897 to 1905, then mayor (president) from 1905 to 1916, and deputy to the 2nd Russian State Duma. He was the first non-Russian mayor of Vilnius since the January Uprising.
